Release Notes

Version 12.7 — March 2026

  • Scheduling: Waitlist notifications now respect provider blackout dates.
  • Claims: Updated payer address book for Q1 2026.
  • Reporting: Export AR dashboard widgets to XLSX.
  • Accessibility: Improved screen reader labels across the scheduling module.

Version 12.6 — January 2026

  • Scheduling: Provider templates now support five-minute slot granularity.
  • Claims: Added 837P validation rules for three additional payers.
  • Coding Assist: Coding Assist recommends CPT and ICD-10 codes from encounter documentation. Recommendations are presented to a certified coder for acceptance; Meridian does not submit codes automatically.
  • Reporting: New denial-reason breakdown widget on the accounts receivable dashboard.
  • Performance: Eligibility check latency reduced by 18%.

Version 12.5 — November 2025

  • Patient Portal: Redesigned appointment confirmation flow.
  • Integrations: HL7v2 ADT feed now supports TLS client certificates.
  • Coding Assist: Expanded specialty coverage to cardiology and orthopedics.

Version 12.4 — September 2025

  • Statements: Paper statement vendor migration completed.
  • Security: Session timeout is now configurable per role.
